BENEFITS

We strive to offer great benefits to our employees, including comprehensive benefits packages, competitive pay, flexible work schedules, and more.

Insurance Benefits

Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage. Flexible Spending Accounts. Health Savings Accounts. Basic Life, Voluntary Life, Short-Term & Voluntary Long-Term Disability Insurance.

401(k) Plan + Bonuses

Saalex offers competitive salaries along with the opportunity to earn bonuses periodically. Our 401(k) plan offers an immediate vesting.

Paid Time Off

Saalex offers paid time off (PTO) as well as 11 paid holidays for time away from work so that you can rest and recharge.

Educational Assistance

Full-time employees are eligible to receive educational assistance after completing their introductory period of employment.

Employee-Owned Company

Participation in the Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) for employees who have worked for Saalex for at least 1,000 hours.

Flexible Work Schedules

Remote work and flexible schedules to help our employees find balance.

Company Events

Holiday parties, summer picnics, happy hour socials, and so much more!
